utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: What's the schedule for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I heard it's this weekend, but I'm not sure about the exact times.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: We should ask someone who knows the exact times, maybe the community board has a flyer.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Hey Noah, I heard about the repair drive. Need any tools from my shed?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, the repair drive? That sounds familiar. Yeah, I think I might need a wrench—thanks, Gus.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure, I've got a set. What size you need, Noah?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey, Pia! Did you hear about the neighborhood repair drive happening this weekend?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Oh, I heard something about it, but I'm a bit worried about the timing. Are we sure we have enough supplies and volunteers?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Don't you worry, I've been rounding up folks all week. We've got a good stack of lumber and paint, and the Johnsons said they'd bring extra tools.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hey Opal, I heard you're organizing a repair drive. How can I help?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great, Sam! I'm mapping out where everyone's dropping off their broken items. Could you help me log their addresses?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure, I can help with that. Just tell me who's dropping off what and I'll write down their addresses.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Uli, have you heard about the neighborhood repair drive this weekend? I'm helping spread the word!

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Oh, repair drive? No, I haven't heard. I've been a bit... distracted lately.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Well, it's this Saturday at the community center from 10 to 4. Bring anything that needs fixing—we've got volunteers for electronics, furniture, and more! You should come.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Leo! I'm so glad you're here. I was just thinking about how we could organize the repair drive this weekend—do you have a moment to talk about it?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sure, what do you need?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Great! I was hoping you could help me coordinate the volunteers—are you free Saturday morning?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: So, what's this about a repair drive, Dane? Can you tell me more details?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Honestly, I just got here and haven't heard much yet. What's the repair drive for?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I'm not sure either, but we should check with someone who might know more.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Hi Mara, are you ready for the repair drive this weekend?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Yes, I'm all set! I've got my tools ready and I'm looking forward to helping out.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, I'm glad you're prepared! I'll be there with my kids helping with the small fixes.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I heard you were organizing a repair drive? What's that all about?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Nell! Yeah, it's a community event where folks bring broken items and we help fix them together. Keeps things out of landfills and builds skills. Want to join?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That sounds neat! I've got an old lamp that's been flickering. Would I be able to bring that?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh, the repair drive? Yeah, I heard something about that. What's the plan?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait, did you say 'repair drive'? Are you sure that's happening?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Uh, maybe I misheard? I thought someone mentioned it at the last block meeting.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: What's the repair drive about?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, I think it's for fixing up the community center or something? I can't quite remember the details.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Hmm, I wish I knew more. Maybe someone else will have the full story.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Hey Cleo, are you going to that repair drive this weekend? I heard they're fixing up old appliances.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Oh yeah, I'll be there! I'm bringing some spare parts I've been saving.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great, I'll let the others know you're bringing spare parts!

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Rey, I heard you were organizing a repair drive? How's that coming along?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: It's going okay, thanks for asking. Just trying to gather some volunteers and tools.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: That sounds like a great idea! What kind of tools do you still need? I might have some in my garage.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, hi Vik! The repair drive... sorry, what was it for again?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: It's to fix those broken benches at the park, remember? We're gathering tools this Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Right, the park benches! I've got a hammer I can bring. What time Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, the repair drive? Sorry, I was just thinking about something else. What's happening with it?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I got it fixed. You need it back?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, great! Yeah, I could use it. Thanks.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Hey Eli, I heard you're organizing a repair drive. I've got plenty of tools I can lend out if anyone needs 'em.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That's mighty kind of you, Gus. I appreciate it. Can you bring them by Saturday morning around nine? I'll have a list of what we need by then.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Eli. I'll be there at nine on Saturday with my tool collection.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hey Quinn, I'm really excited about the repair drive tomorrow. Have you gathered the tools yet?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, I've been so busy spreading the word, I haven't had a chance to gather tools yet! But I'm sure we'll pull it all together.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: No worries, Quinn! I've got my toolbox ready to go. Want me to swing by and help round up the rest?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hi Opal! I heard you're organizing the repair drive—need any help connecting folks?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: That would be great, Jules! I've got a list of folks who need repairs and their neighborhoods mapped out—maybe you can help me match them with the volunteers who live nearby.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Sounds perfect! Why don't you share that map with me, and I'll start matching folks up right away?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Cleo! I'm so glad you're here. I wanted to chat about our upcoming repair drive and see if you have any ideas.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Oh, I've been inventorying what we have—tons of fabric, but we're low on zippers and thread.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Great work on the inventory! Let's put out a call for zippers and thread; I know a few neighbors who might have extras.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I heard there's a repair drive happening? What's that about?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Yeah, it's a community event where we fix broken items instead of throwing them away. You bring something, and volunteers help repair it.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That sounds great! I have a broken toaster I've been meaning to fix. Can I bring it?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hey Faye, did you get that repair drive sorted out?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Repair drive? I'm not sure what you mean—can you remind me?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: The one for fixing the router—you mentioned it yesterday.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hey Kira, what's this about a repair drive? How can I help?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait, what repair drive? Are you sure we're talking about the same thing?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Oh, I must've misunderstood. I heard some folks talking about a community repair drive, but maybe I got the details wrong.
